ModMetaData.description:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2890901044][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CombatExtended-Continued/CombatExtended/master/Media/Badge_CE_compatible.png[/img][/url] [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_Suite.png[/img] [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_Tactics.png[/img]
RimWorld mod that improves pawn decision-making for the interactions and circumstances that surface when [url=https://github.com/CombatExtended-Continued/CombatExtended]Combat Extended[/url] and [url=https://github.com/PeteTimesSix/SimpleSidearms]Simple Sidearms[/url] are patched together by this suite's [url=https://github.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch]CE + Simple Sidearms Compatibility patch[/url].
[h1]Features[/h1] Installing the mod turns them on; every feature has its own settings toggle. [list] [*]A pawn mid-reload with a hostile in range aborts and switches to a loaded carried weapon instead of finishing the reload. [*]A drafted pawn reloads its unequipped sidearms during a combat lull. [*]Melee-weapon choice weighs the target's armor (blunt vs armored, fast blades vs flesh). [*]Gun choice weighs the target's armor and the gun's loaded ammo (penetration vs armor, EMP vs mechs). Never switches or reloads ammo. [*]A pawn switches to a sidearm rather than hold a forced weapon that has run completely out of ammo (off by default). [*]When two carried guns rank about equally, the one with deeper ammo reserves wins. [/list]
[h1]Load order[/h1] Harmony → Combat Extended → Simple Sidearms → CE+SS Compatibility → this mod.
[h1]My other mods[/h1] [b]The CE + Simple Sidearms suite[/b] — the core compatibility patch this module requires, and the other module in the suite. [table] [tr][th]Module[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_Patch.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Core compatibility patch for Combat Extended and Simple Sidearms.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Loadouts][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_Loadouts.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Syncs loadouts between Combat Extended and Simple Sidearms.[/td][/tr] [/table]
[b]Standalone[/b] — none of these need the patch, or each other. [table] [tr][th]Mod[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/Better-Attack-Orders-for-Simple-Sidearms][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_BAO.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Adds sidearm attack orders to the right-click target menu.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/Loadout-Quality-for-Combat-Extended][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_LQ.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Pawns upgrade their held guns when a higher-quality copy is available.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][url=https://github.com/eebette/Universal-Patch-for-More-Materials][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eebette/CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms-Compatibility-Patch/main/Media/Badge_UPMM.png[/img][/url][/td][td]Adds materials from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3055040889]More Materials[/url] to non-vanilla recipes.[/td][/tr] [/table]
[h1]FAQ[/h1] [b]CE compatible?[/b] I'm not answering that.
[b]Can I add or remove it mid-save?[/b] Yep.
[b]Does it change balance?[/b] It makes the game easier in the sense that 2 core combat mods work better together.
[b]AI?[/b] This mod was engineered with the help of an AI Coding Assistant (Claude Code, Fable 5, Max effort). The amount of researching and deep-diving the compatibility interfaces of the mods it patches would have been insurmountable without it.
Development followed a standard process driven and scrutinized by me (the real human person writing this): explore, design, build, test, fix, review, scrutinize, test again over many rounds.
I have manually reviewed and verified all code in this mod.
I ask that if you have unconstructive feedback regarding the usage of AI while developing this mod, that it remains outside of this community space. Thank you.
